text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync  pricing page experiment readiness. Need final QA on: FAQ copy, new tier labels, calculator microcopy, and the inbound routing. Aim to lock the launch post by EOD tomorrow.

Liam O'Sullivan: Routing plan v2: calculator submissions -> POST /webhooks/pricing_calc -> SFDC queue 'marketing_pricing_calc'. Webinar sign-ups -> mql_webinar + campaign=pricing-launch-apr. I'll push the mapping and provide sample payloads.

Priya Nair: Tier naming proposal: 'Hobby', 'Team', 'Scale' felt off for enterprise buyers. My rec: 'Starter', 'Business', 'Enterprise' (mirrors our support tiers). Keeps messaging consistent across docs. :+1:

Josh Rivera: UI nit: add tooltip under estimator headline: "Powered by typical usage profiles; use the slider to adjust seq length." Also we should A/B test two CTAs: variant A 'Estimate your monthly' vs variant B 'Get a pricing estimate' on 50/50.

Elena Gomez: FYI ops needs the exact field that carries the estimate for segmentation. Also need an opt-in flag for outreach: 'allow_sales_contact' boolean.

Liam O'Sullivan: Example webhook payload (use est_tokens for segmentation):```json
{
  "source": "pricing_calculator",
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "est_tokens": 80000,
  "tier_interest": "Business",
  "referrer": "/pricing",
  "allow_sales_contact": true
}
```

Maya Chen: Draft FAQ Qs I'm pushing: "How accurate is this estimator?", "Will I get contacted after submitting?", "Can I lock in discounted rates?". Proposed short answers in staging doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pricing-faq-draft. Please skim and flag any legal/compliance issues.

Priya Nair: Suggest small change to FAQ phrasing for accuracy: replace "firm quote" with "custom quote from sales" to avoid implying binding pricing.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy: pricing-faq.md deployed to staging at 2024-03-22T03:15:12Z. Preview: https://staging.redwood/docs/pricing-faq

Josh Rivera: Nurture flow for calc leads: immediate summary email (include estimator results + CTA), 3-day follow up (feature tips), 7-day case study + invite to upcoming webinar. Tag leads as 'calc_lead' and metric: percent who request demo.

Maya Chen: Action list: Priya finalize tier labels + copy by EOD, Liam provide webhook & payload doc, Elena update SFDC mapping, Josh write two email variants and set nurture cadence. I'll draft the launch post once items are green. :rocket:

Liam O'Sullivan: I'll also add a hidden param 'experiment_cta' so we can tie A/B test back to conversions.

Maya Chen: Perfect. If there are no blockers, I'll schedule the webinar co-present with infra on the demo. Meeting to confirm slides Friday 11a.

Elena Gomez: I'll need the final field map and sample records before Monday to update auto-assignment rules.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. We'll regroup after the deploy verification. :white_check_mark:
